_doc: The shared schema contract between arbiter (ontology owner) and forma (derivation and lens layer). Each entry names the repo that OWNS a schema, the path it lives at inside that repo, its sha256, and the repos that VENDOR a pinned copy. Both repos carry a byte-identical copy of this file and each gates its own half: arbiter runs scripts/check-forma-contract.mjs, forma runs scripts/check-arbiter-contract.mjs. A schema edited without re-pinning turns the owning repo red immediately; a stale vendored copy turns the consuming repo red. Neither repo may unilaterally change a shared shape and stay green.

schemas.why: forma defined the stack-agnostic C4 graph first and generates it; arbiter adopts that shape rather than inventing a second C4 standard, and vendors a pinned copy so its own generators and gates can validate a model without depending on forma at runtime.
arbiter owns the identifier ontology. forma will vendor this when its provenance lens renders scheme-aware citations; listed now with no consumers so the pin exists before the dependency does.
